notes.title: "Missing Executable" PATCH (12/1/2017)
notes.notes:
Today's patch (12/1/2017) fixed the "Missing Executable" Error.
The problem has been completely destroyed and Lone Leader is available to play again! 
 Sorry for this issue, enjoy playing! ːscaryclownː
